info.title: Photo Organizer Sidecar API
info.description: Local-only FastAPI sidecar for the offline photo organizer. Wraps database.py and ai_core.py for Tauri desktop integration.

get.summary: Health check for Tauri sidecar readiness probes
get.description: Simple liveness endpoint (no auth — localhost only).

post.description:
Recursively scan a local folder for JPG/PNG images.

Heavy AI work runs in a background asyncio task using worker threads so this
endpoint returns immediately with `{ "status": "started", "total_files": N }`.

get.description:
Return live scanning metrics from the thread-safe global state object.

Frontend should poll this endpoint while `is_active` is true.

get.summary: Search photos containing ALL named people (intersection)
get.description:
Strict relational intersection search via DatabaseManager.get_photos_by_names.

Only photos where EVERY listed person appears together are returned.

parameters.name: names

schema.description: Comma-separated person names (AND / intersection). Example: Magda,Łukasz
schema.title: Names

parameters.description: Comma-separated person names (AND / intersection). Example: Magda,Łukasz

schema.title: Response Get Search Api Search Get

get.summary: List photos with optional person intersection and AI processed filters
get.description:
Gallery listing for the desktop UI.

When person_ids is omitted or empty, returns all photos (subject to ai_status).
When one person_id is set, returns every photo that contains that person (group shots included).
When multiple person_ids are set, returns photos where every listed person appears together.

parameters.name: person_ids

schema.description: Comma-separated people.id values (AND / intersection). Empty = no person filter.
schema.title: Person Ids

parameters.description: Comma-separated people.id values (AND / intersection). Empty = no person filter.

parameters.name: ai_status

schema.description: Filter by ingestion status: all | processed | unprocessed | faceless.
schema.title: Ai Status

parameters.description: Filter by ingestion status: all | processed | unprocessed | faceless.

schema.title: Response Get Gallery Api Gallery Get

get.summary: List unnamed DBSCAN clusters with exemplar face geometry
get.description:
Return unnamed clusters with bounding boxes for face-centered UI thumbnails.

DBSCAN noise faces (cluster_id NULL) are excluded by the database layer.

schema.title: Response Get Unnamed Clusters Api Clusters Unnamed Get

get.summary: List DBSCAN noise faces awaiting manual assignment
get.description:
Return unassigned faces with no named cluster (``cluster_id IS NULL`` or ``< 0``).

Thumbnail URLs point at the parent photo preview for each detection.

schema.title: Response Get Noise Faces Api Clusters Noise Get

post.summary: Assign a display name to an unnamed DBSCAN cluster
post.description: Name a DBSCAN cluster or assign a single noise face to a new/existing person.

post.summary: Merge two person records into one identity
post.description:
Reassign all faces from `source_person_id` to `target_person_id` and delete the source.

Uses DatabaseManager.merge_person_clusters(target_person_id, source_person_id).

get.summary: List all identified people with face counts and exemplar photos
get.description:
Return every person row with aggregate statistics for the UI gallery.

Uses DatabaseManager.get_all_people_with_face_counts().

schema.title: Response Get People Api People Get

get.summary: Serve a JPEG thumbnail for a person's exemplar photo
get.description: Resolve the lowest linked face for the person to a photo, then stream its thumbnail.

parameters.name: height

schema.description: Optional maximum height; aspect ratio preserved when omitted.
schema.title: Height

parameters.description: Optional maximum height; aspect ratio preserved when omitted.

get.summary: Serve a cached JPEG thumbnail for a photo
get.description:
Stream a downscaled JPEG thumbnail from `.thumbnail_cache/`.

On cache miss the image is resized with Pillow (LANCZOS) and stored as JPEG quality 85.

parameters.name: height

schema.description: Optional maximum height; aspect ratio preserved when omitted.
schema.title: Height

parameters.description: Optional maximum height; aspect ratio preserved when omitted.

get.summary: Stream the original photo file from disk
get.description: Return the full-resolution source image for gallery lightbox viewing.

get.summary: List every photo containing at least one face in the cluster
get.description:
Return all images where any detected face belongs to ``cluster_id``.

Multi-face photos are included when at least one face matches; other faces in the
same image are ignored for filtering purposes.

schema.title: Response Get Cluster Photos Api Clusters  Cluster Id  Photos Get

get.description: Resolve the lowest unassigned face in the cluster to a photo, then stream its thumbnail.
